summary: 3DNow! 4D vector transform helper (__stdcall). Reads a 4-component input vector a2 (two __m64 words), pairs the components via punpckldq/punpckhdq, accumulates SIMD products against the coefficient table a3[0..7] (pfmul/pfadd), divides through the w component using a refined 3DNow reciprocal (pfrcp/pfrcpit1/pfrcpit2), writes the transformed result into a1 (a1[0] as a full __m64 product, a1[1].m64_i32[0] as a truncated 32-bit value) and returns a1. Emits _m_femms() at entry and exit.

operations.description: Emit the 3DNow state transition _m_femms() at entry and again before returning.
Load the input vector: m64_u64 = a2[0] and v5 = a2[1].m64_u32[0], the two words of the 4D input vector.
Duplicate vector components into paired words with punpckldq/punpckhdq, building v4, v6 and v7 for the subsequent SIMD multiply-accumulates.
Accumulate v8 = a3[2]*v6 + a3[4]*v7 via pfmul/pfadd.
Accumulate v9 = a3[1]*v4 + a3[7] + a3[3]*v6 + a3[5]*v7 via nested pfmul/pfadd.
Compute the reciprocal of v9's paired component with the 3DNow refinement sequence pfrcp, pfrcpit1, pfrcpit2 into v12.
Write the transformed result: a1[0] = (a3[0]*v4 + a3[6] + v8) * v12 as a full __m64, and a1[1].m64_i32[0] = (v9 * v12) truncated to a 32-bit integer.
Restore x87/MMX state with _m_femms() and return the output pointer a1.
Invoked by QuaternionTransformComposition (0x005267A7), MatrixInterpolationBlend (0x0052692F) and F_3DNowVectorTransform (0x00526B55) to apply a 3DNow 4D vector transform.
